parameters.name: DatasetMaxBindCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of bindings for each dataset. Valid values: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxEntityCount
parameters.description:
The maximum number of metadata entities (including data files, file relationships, and clustering groups) in each dataset. The maximum value is 2^63-1.
>This is a reserved parameter and is not enforced during use.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxFileCount
parameters.description: The maximum number of files in each dataset. Valid values: 1 to 100000000.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxRelationCount
parameters.description:
The maximum number of metadata relationships in each dataset. The maximum value is 2^63-1.
>This is a reserved parameter and is not enforced during use.

parameters.name: DatasetMaxTotalFileSize
parameters.description: The maximum total file size in each dataset. After this limit is exceeded, no more indexes can be added. The maximum value is 2^63-1. Unit: bytes.

parameters.name: DatasetName
parameters.description: The dataset name. For information about how to obtain the dataset name, see [Create a dataset](~~478160~~).

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The workflow template ID. For more information, see [Workflow templates and operators](~~466304~~).
